nt2e81.title: Capricorn's Quarterly Feelings Review
nt2e81.caption: Capricorn really built a slide deck to say "every Sunday, same diner, you." Honestly? Approved. Which sign in your life would schedule a recurring date?

nt2e82.title: Virgo Runs the Sync
nt2e82.caption: "Quick sync?" means I miss you. "Circle back" means I need a minute. Virgo translated, finally. What's the most corporate thing you've ever texted a crush?

nt2e83.title: Gemini's All-Hands Apology
nt2e83.caption: Gemini looped in stakeholders (the best friend) and then took full ownership. Growth, presented in slides. Tag the friend who apologizes like a press release.

nt2e84.title: Libra Tables the Motion
nt2e84.caption: Libra tabled dinner, pushed the label to next quarter, then went first on feelings. A full arc in one meeting. Which sign takes longest to pick a restaurant?

nt2e85.title: Scorpio's Deep Dive
nt2e85.caption: Scorpio's deep dive starts at your childhood and ends at "I want to meet your best friend." Intense? Yes. Into it? Also yes. Who's your Scorpio?

nt2e86.title: Cancer and the Different Goodnight
nt2e86.caption: Cancer built an entire case file over a star instead of a moon. The answer was: they fell asleep. Be honest, how many exhibits have you made over one text?

nt2e87.title: Aries Texts First (Again)
nt2e87.caption: Aries presented three exhibits and the jury said send it. Waiting around was never the plan. Are you a text-first sign or a wait-and-see sign?
